item.title: St. Louis proposes new rules on data centers
item.description: St. Louis city officials have proposed new rules to regulate data center development, restricting where data centers could be built and setting strict and operational requirements.

item.title: $1 million prize won from scratcher ticket in Wentzville
item.description: A Missouri Lottery player in St. Charles County has claimed an $1 million prize from a Scratchers ticket. According to the Missouri Lottery, the winning $10 ticket was bought at the FastLane gas station at 21 E. Highway N, in Wentzville.

item.title: Man critically injured in South St. Louis shooting
item.description: District 2 detectives from the St. Louis Metropolitan Police Department (SLMPD) say they responded to a shooting in South St. Louis that left one person critically injured Friday afternoon.

item.title: Demolition to begin in Cades Cove after radioactive contamination discovered
item.description: Demolition is scheduled to begin Monday in the Cades Cove subdivision after radioactive contamination was discovered in Coldwater Creek.

item.title: Who is David Hoffmann? Billionaire says he wants to buy the St. Louis Cardinals
item.description: David Hoffmann, a Missouri-raised entrepreneur and billionaire, has publicly expressed interest in buying the St. Louis Cardinals if the franchise is put up for sale, according to a St. Louis Business Journal report.

item.title: Large ice formation falls from downtown STL condo building
item.description: As temperatures warmed on Friday, the ice formation fell to the ground, pulling down sections of a frozen downspout with it.

item.title: 2 water main breaks raise safety concerns in St. Louis
item.description: Two days later, two main emergencies and concerns from residents are growing about what's happening beneath St. Louis City streets.

item.title: Mardi Gras season officially underway in Soulard
item.description: This weekend kicks off the celebrations with family-friendly events, like the Taste of Soulard, giving businesses a preview of the big crowds expected the following weekend.

item.title: Police link dealership thefts across Pacific, Eureka
item.description: Police believe a string of break-ins at three different car dealerships in Pacific and Eureka are all connected.

item.title: Doctors testify infant was healthy in Illinois baby death trial
item.description: 3-month-old Jameson Shires, from Highland Illinois, died in March 2023, reportedly from shaken baby syndrome. The baby’s father, Dustin Shires, was charged with murder.
